text:
alex_sales: Cyphex RFP got routed to us. Asks: private VPC deploy, customer-managed HSM, mandatory PII redaction at source OR cryptographic proof HSM never exposes plaintext. They want capability matrix + 10-day POC plan + ballpark pricing by Wed. Can SE/SRE scope?

mira_se: Can you paste the exact clause and link? Need to confirm if tokenization is acceptable for matching and audit.

alex_sales: Link: https://cyphex.example/rfp/cyphex-2026.pdf. Excerpt: "No plaintext personal data may leave customer network unless customer-managed HSM guarantees vendor never has access to unwrapped keys." POC focus: messages + attachments + audit trail.

jon_sre: For BYO-HSM we support KMIP proxy (mutual TLS) and on-prem appliance. KMIP requires VPC peering and in-subnet unwrap. ETA 24-72h after network details.

mira_se: I'll draft three approaches in the matrix: (A) client SDK tokenization, (B) Private in-customer subnet with HSM proxy, (C) on-prem appliance. Include quick tradeoffs: latency, ops, compliance.

tara_pricing: Draft placeholders: POC (10d) $15k, Dedicated $7k/mo, Private setup $50k + $8k/mo, Appliance integration $90k+. Mark as draft.

li_legal: If they require zero vendor key access, escalate to on-prem SOW and change liability/maintenance clauses. Also check whether Cyphex accepts our SOC2 + pen-test summary.

mira_se: POC deliverables to list: sample redaction flow, attachment handling with tokenization, throughput smoke at 60 rps (1KB), E2E signed audit traces showing no plaintext egress, integration runbook + firewall checklist.

jon_sre: Firewall snippet for runbook: ```
# example peer rules
allow tcp 443 from cyphex-admin to redwood-private-proxy:443
allow tcp 10250-10255 from redwood-control to cyphex-admin
```

attachments-bot: uploaded "cyphex-rfp.pdf" and "cyphex-capmatrix-draft.csv" (internal links).

alex_sales: Action items: Mira - update capmatrix with A/B/C and POC bullets by Tue EOD. Jon - provide provisioning ETA + HA notes. Tara - validate draft numbers with pricing ops. Li - review RFP and flag contract language. I'll set a security sync for Wed 10am CET. :thumbsup:
